subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Ethnic Cleansing

options.text: Worshiping of a certain ethnic or religious group on a massive scale
Killing of a certain ethnic or religious group on a massive scale
One who was previously unknown and is now prominent
A large number of people either falling ill or dying

solution:
The correct answer is: "**Killing of a certain ethnic or religious group on a massive scale.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The term "**ethnic cleansing**" refers to the deliberate and systematic killing or displacement of a particular ethnic or religious group. (एक निश्चित जाति या धार्मिक समूह के भयानक पैमाने पर हत्या)
 
 
• **Example**: "*Ethnic cleansing led to a tragic loss of lives and displacement.*"
 
 
 
• This is often done with the intention of creating a homogenous society or territory.
 
• The term gained prominence during the Balkan conflicts of the 1990s, when Serb forces carried out a campaign of ethnic cleansing against Bosniak Muslims and Croats.
 
• Ethnic cleansing is considered a crime against humanity under international law.
 
• This idiom is associated with human rights abuses and war crimes.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.
